## Staffing what-if (ODLH planning indicator)

- Entry mode: hours
- Formula version: WHATIF-1.0
- This is a labeled PLANNING INDICATOR only, never an official ODLH compliance determination. It does not compute or claim the agency's real, current ODLH compliance status.
- Framed as evidence toward suitability criterion (a)(2) — the NPA's qualifications to satisfactorily perform the work — only. It is not itself a suitability determination; the Commission determines suitability.
- Enter DIRECT labor hours only — supervisory and indirect hours are excluded from the ODLH computation entirely (owner-attested, ADR-020).
- Context (owner-attested, ADR-020): a per-PL-project or product-family ratio (PLDLH, a.k.a. EDLH — "Estimated Direct Hours") may be Commission-approved BELOW the 75% floor, permissible only while the agency maintains the 75% ODLH ratio overall. This what-if computes the AGENCY-WIDE ODLH ratio only; it does not compute a per-project PLDLH/EDLH figure.
- This is an END-STATE delta only — the difference once the scenario's staffing is fully in place. Ramp timing is site-dependent (an incumbent-workforce transition ramps differently than mass recruiting, owner-attested) and is not modeled here.

- The scenario's assumed qualifying share/count is an ANALYST ASSUMPTION about a workforce not yet hired — UNVERIFIED supply, not observed evidence.
- Baseline (observed): 78,000 qualifying hours of 120,000 total hours — 65.0%
- Scenario addition (assumed): 15,000 qualifying hours of 20,000 total hours added
- Scenario (baseline + addition): 93,000 qualifying hours of 140,000 total hours — 66.4%
- Delta: +1.4 pp (scenario minus baseline)
